# Sarasa Gothic SC

StickMon's Chinese `StickMon Bitmap 16` resource is generated from Sarasa
Gothic SC Regular 1.0.40. ASCII glyphs are excluded from the generated pack.

- Upstream: https://github.com/be5invis/Sarasa-Gothic
- Upstream release: https://github.com/be5invis/Sarasa-Gothic/releases/tag/v1.0.40
- Regular: `SarasaGothicSC-Regular.ttf`
  - SHA-256: `6541a94ad09601b71dff4100360807f4bb2068a0d5fe8b76c71a75e0cb6cf749`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `LICENSE.txt`

The original TTF keeps its upstream font name. The generated bitmap resource
uses the project-specific name above and remains covered by the OFL.
